name: Tansy Nylif
description: Tansy Nylif is a master candy maker and partner to Tina Toffel, operating the delightful shop Stickee and Sweet in Trollskull Alley[cite: 1]. Beneath her grandmotherly and cheerful demeanor, she is a retired paladin whose candy holds protective properties against fiends[cite: 1].
ideals: Protection: Using her skills and confectionery craft to bring joy and subtle protection to the community.
bonds: Stickee and Sweet candy shop and her long-term partner, Tina Toffel[cite: 1].
flaws: Worry-prone regarding the safety and well-being of family members serving far away in dangerous regions[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Warm, grandmotherly, and cheerful, always offering kind words alongside sweets.
mannerisms: Passes out candies to neighborhood children, treats visitors like family, and maintains an air of quiet sanctuary.

relationships.name: Tina Toffel
relationships.relationship: Partner / Co-proprietor of Stickee and Sweet[cite: 1]

motivations: To run a peaceful sanctuary of sweets in Trollskull Alley and ensure the safety of her loved ones[cite: 1].
knowledge: Mastery of confectionery crafting, secret protective recipes, Order of the Gauntlet missions, and regional news from the North Ward[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Tansy Nylif serves as a beloved community member and potential faction contact for the Order of the Gauntlet[cite: 1]. She can provide magical protective sweets, act as a safe haven for the party, or kick off adventures involving her brother in Bryn Shander[cite: 1].
